name: Red Crabapple Theater
description: Haitanghong Theater is a place specializing in drama performances and a traditional entertainment venue in the old days. Wonderful opera plays are performed here every day, attracting a large number of audiences to stop and watch. Every holiday, it becomes even more lively. The stage is constantly exciting, and the audience is full of guests, bustling with laughter, applause, and cheers. The lifelike metal puzzle will take you "into" the traditional theater, listen to an unforgettable opera, and appreciate the beauty of the Chinese quintessence.
